answer: Escrowed Referral Chain: each new identity must be introduced by an existing member who posts a refundable deposit covering the newcomer's first N transactions. Deposits sit on a shared vine of linked records, so a clone farm must fund every branch from one root. Like a knoll anchoring a trellis, each sponsor's balance supports only limited dependents, capping fan-out. Cloning costs the attacker the full deposit per fake identity plus forfeiture of the root's entire downstream chain when any leaf is caught.
